title: What If Every Satellite Switched Off Today?

scenes.text: What if every satellite switched off today? The first thing to fail wouldn't be your map.
It would be time itself. Navigation satellites carry the precise clocks that phone networks, power grids and bank systems rely on.
Right away, ATMs would stop dispensing cash, stock trading would halt, and mobile networks would start to fail.
Planes couldn't navigate, so air travel would become impossible. Power grids that use satellite clocks would lose precision.
Weather forecasts would stop, live TV broadcasts would end, and rescue teams would lose their view of floods and fires.
GPS isn't about maps, it's about time. And there is no backup system ready to replace it.
